## Loki Explore

Click a link to open Loki Explore filtered to a common Telemetron stream.

- **All Telemetron stack logs**: [`{job="telemetron"}`](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22loki%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22expr%22%3A%22%7Bjob%3D%5C%22telemetron%5C%22%7D%22%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D)
- **Per-service shortcuts**: `{service_name="telemetron-grafana"}`, `{service_name="telemetron-loki"}`, `{service_name="telemetron-prometheus"}`, `{service_name="telemetron-alertmanager"}`.
- **Errors only**: `{job="telemetron"} |= "error" | json | __error__ = ""`.

### Trace-to-logs

Logs from OTel-SDK-instrumented apps carry `trace_id` as structured metadata. Click the **View in Tempo** link beside any log line containing `trace_id` to jump to the matching trace.

See `roles/grafana/README.md` -> Trace-to-logs correlation for the honest scope (FB-tailed Docker stdout/stderr does NOT carry `trace_id` unless the app embeds it).
